title: Schematify and app download system built by maintainer
context: OpenKaava has first-party tools that are part of the core product. Community contribution is welcome, but on the right foundation.
decision: Schematify and the app download system are built by the maintainer (Braden). Not because outside help is unwelcome, but so nobody spends a weekend on a foundation that is already half-written. Once each one exists, features and quality-of-life work on top are exactly where an outside change lands best.
consequences: Outside contributors cannot write Schematify from scratch or build the download system. They can contribute features on top of the maintainer's foundation. A roadmap and starter issues will point to exactly where contributions fit best.
